featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sardar Pavbhaji, the oldest pav bhaji hotel in Tadeo, is a must-visit for all pav bhaji lovers. Known for their delicious pav bhaji, they serve up a perfect blend of quality and generous portions.
The inviting environment and cooperative staff enhance your dining experience, making it a popular spot for locals and visitors alike.
With an authentic taste that highlights the perfect balance of spices in their bhaji, each bite is a delight.
Whether you're craving a quick snack or a hearty meal, Sardar Pavbhaji promises satisfaction every time.
Don't miss out on savoring their signature dish that continues to delight patrons year after year!

featured_reviews.name: Prashant K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Old and very famous place in that area.
Food- Food taste was amazing and quantity was also very good. Amount of butter included in the dish almost overshadowed the taste of Bhaji.
Service- It was good.
Atmosphere- Being from other city, felt it little congested but I guess for Mumbaikars it will be a good place as it has good ventilation and ample light.

Overall a very good experience at this place.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: Good food. They make both pav and  bhaji on coal. U have to wait in queue if there's rush. There's no AC seating so going in summers is a bit rough. The service is very quick and efficient. It is a pure veg place, they serve refreshments alongside pav bhaji. The pav bhaji is a little on the expensive side n gets pretty heavy to eat due to all the butter but worth it. The quality is good, the hygiene is great, ambience is pretty decent and clean. The service is super fast too. One might not go there often but it's a Good place to visit once in a while for a buttery treat.

featured_reviews.review_text: Sardar Pav Bhaji serves delicious and flavorful pav bhaji with rich buttery taste 😋 😁 and perfectly spiced bhaji. featured_reviews.name: 088_kruti patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1. Legendary Taste:
Sardar Pav Bhaji is truly iconic! The pav bhaji here is rich, buttery, and bursting with flavor 🧈🔥. Every bite feels heavenly and perfectly balanced with spice and butter.

⭐ 2. Generous Butter Topping:
The huge dollop of Amul butter on top is the highlight 😍. It melts beautifully into the bhaji, making it creamy and irresistible!

⭐ 3. Quick Service:
Even though it’s always crowded, the service is super fast ⚡. The staff manages everything efficiently and ensures everyone gets hot pav bhaji quickly.

⭐ 4. Clean and Organized:
The place is neat, hygienic, and well-maintained 🧼. You can comfortably enjoy your food without any hassle.

⭐ 5. Perfect Mumbai Vibe:
The atmosphere is full of energy and local charm 🌆. You can feel the true spirit of Mumbai while eating here.

⭐ 6. Must-Try Experience:
Whether you’re a local or a tourist, Sardar Pav Bhaji is a must-visit spot ❤️. It’s a perfect blend of taste, tradition, and Mumbai magic!

✨ Highly Recommended for Every Food Lover! 😍🥰

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
An unforgettable Thai brunch experience that truly transported us straight to the bustling streets of Bangkok 🇹🇭✨
We recently attended the Tuk Tuk Tales pop-up at Plate & Pint curated by the incredibly talented Chef Akanksha Saigal, and every single dish on the menu reflected her passion, creativity, and deep understanding of authentic Thai flavours.
We went as a group of friends for brunch, and honestly, it turned into one of those meals where every plate sparks conversation, every bite feels memorable, and time just flies by over great food and even better company. The vibe at Plate & Pint added so much warmth to the experience — lively, cozy, vibrant, and perfect for a long indulgent afternoon.
The meal began with the Mango & Avocado Ceviche — incredibly fresh, bright, and beautifully balanced with chilli, lime, cilantro, green apple, and crispy shallots adding layers of texture and zing. A refreshing start that instantly awakened the palate.
The Crispy Potato Stacks were an absolute standout. Perfectly crisp with rich green curry notes, aromatic fried basil, chilli crackling, and toasted herb rice bringing together comfort and complexity in every bite.
The Gai Yang Thai BBQ Chicken was beautifully charred and deeply flavourful, paired wonderfully with pickled cucumber, pickled chilli, and a delicious dipping sauce that elevated the smokiness of the chicken.
The Spicy Tamarind Glaze dishes were another highlight. Both the cottage cheese and pork belly versions were packed with bold sweet spicy flavours and had that addictive Thai style balance that keeps you reaching for another bite.
For mains, the Holy Basil Stir Fry was pure comfort food done right. Fragrant basil, juicy chicken, cucumber, fluffy rice, and a fried egg made this dish hearty, satisfying, and incredibly soulful.
The Tom Yum Hot Pot was bursting with authentic Thai aromatics — lemongrass, galangal, lime leaf — with the prawns soaking beautifully in the deeply comforting broth. Warm, sharp, spicy, and layered with flavour.
And of course, no Thai meal feels complete without a great Pad Thai, and this one absolutely delivered. Perfectly cooked rice noodles coated in tamarind sauce with chicken, bean sprouts, and peanuts creating the ideal balance of sweet, savoury, nutty, and tangy flavours.
Dessert was the perfect finale — Mango Sticky Rice with tender coconut ice cream. Rich, fragrant, comforting, and tropical all at once. Easily one of the best versions we’ve had in Mumbai.
The cocktails were equally thoughtful and fun, especially the Thai Chilli Guava Michelada and Mango Chilli White Wine Spritz, which paired beautifully with the food and added another vibrant layer to the entire experience.
Huge compliments to Chef Akanksha for creating such a well executed pop-up that didn’t just serve food, but genuinely told a story through flavours. Every dish felt curated with heart and authenticity.
Thank you for inviting us and giving us such a memorable afternoon filled with laughter, amazing conversations, delicious food, and beautiful hospitality. Experiences like these are exactly why food brings people together so effortlessly.

Already looking forward to the next one ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is a great pick in breach candy if you’re craving Pure Veg Mexican flavors with a creative twist. Started with the Cantina Nachos made with gluten-free corn—they were perfectly crunchy, fresh, and loaded with cheese. The Tex Mex Classic Burger was a highlight, with a crispy potato patty paired beautifully with black beans, cheese sauce, fresh salsa, guacamole, and pickled onions—every bite had a nice balance of textures and flavors.

The Guacamole Toast was simple yet delicious, a healthier option that didn’t compromise on taste. But the real surprise was the Mexican Pizza—super unique with a cheesy base at the bottom and top, layered with salsa in between. It’s something you don’t come across often and definitely worth trying.

For drinks, the Mango Inferno stood out with its sweet and spicy combination, especially with that bold hit of red chillies. The Jalamelon was equally refreshing—juicy watermelon with a hint of jalapeños giving it a nice kick.

Ended the meal with the Quattro Leche dessert, a rich and indulgent take on the classic three-milk dessert, and it was the perfect way to wrap things up.

On top of the food, the place offers comfortable indoor as well as outdoor seating, making it ideal for both casual hangouts and relaxed dining. Overall, a well-rounded experience with good food, interesting flavors, and a chill vibe.

• Chocolate Massacre: To end on a high note, this dessert is a chocolate lover's dream. It’s rich, gooey, and lives up to its name in the best way possible.
The Drinks
Their bottled beverages, like the Fizzarito and Lymang Magic, are incredibly refreshing and serve as the perfect palate cleanser between spicy bites.
Final Verdict
Whether you’re looking for a quick takeaway or a cute spot for a casual date night, this place is a solid choice. Great portions, vibrant atmosphere, and authentic flavors.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flute 24 Hrs had a mixed dining experience overall.

The starters were quite good and flavourful. We ordered the Korean Style Chicken and Murgh Phoolzadi Kebab, both of which were enjoyable and well prepared.

However, the mains was a disappointment. We ordered the Murg Angara, and it lacked proper flavour and tasted quite off compared to the strong start from the appetizers. I also felt the recommendation for the mains could have been better.

Something unique about Flute in comparison to most other restaurants is that a 5% service fee is included and charged to the bill. This is interesting because tipping in India is optional as far as I am aware. This resulted in a modest increase in the bill of around ₹100 for the three dishes. However I would usually tip more but because the service fee was included it made little sense to top anything and felt somewhat redundant.

The service was nice as per my expectation but this practice is one which I have encountered in few restaurants and certainly is not a norm and so is something to be aware about.

The restaurant otherwise was good though but slightly priced on the premium side.

I thought some items were inappropriately priced. One small roti at ₹88 (excluding any taxes) seemed like a rip off because it averaged 3-4 rotis on just one dish so felt a bit unusual seeing ₹300 on a side dish of a basic small roti.

That said, the ambience was quite nice. The restaurant was air-conditioned, comfortable and relaxing, with an IPL match playing alongside mild instrumental music which made for a calm dining atmosphere.

Overall, good starters and ambience, but inconsistent mains and somewhat inflated pricing.

featured_reviews.name: Shamit Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros
1. Low Sugar content
2. Strawberry and Classic are fantastic base options
3. Wide variety of toppings
4. Deceptively filling (A large could take 30 minutes to finish casually)
5. 6th day of every month carries a one on one free offer that's a no brainer grab
Cons
1. Base options are limited otherwise. No pineapple, coffee, chocolate, saffron, pistachio, Greek etc.
2. Servings cannot be customised. Most yogurt joints have a self-serve option that charges you only based on the weight, irrespective of the toppings or mixture of yogurt types.
3. Toppings are variegated but sorted differently with respect to the price. Basic toppings like chocolate fudge sauce, Nutella, compotes are placed in the premium category.

Yogurt has become a jargon for the person who really is seeking a tasty and healthy option. Its insanely difficult to find a good yogurt joint because they sprout with marketing gimmicks and delectable flavours that are artificially concocted calorie bombs.
I hadn't outright decided to try 6th street yogurt. My friend persuaded me to join him on the 6th because he had heard about it from a mutual friend. It's easy to spot from the main road as it is just round the corner of a lane at the foot of Kemps Corner.
There are 4 offerings of Yogurt flavours. Classic with a tinge of vanilla, Strawberry, Cranberry Melon and Blueberry. On inquiring with the employee I was told that all the flavours were 100% natural. They let you taste each to make a more decisive pick. I stuck my guns with the original and mounted it with dark chocolate and walnut fudge sauce for a healthy calorie intake. To my surprise, it was actually under-sweet.
Toppings are gamut. You got Oreo, chocolate chips and other chocolate based sauces, Compotes, fresh cut fruits, dried fruits and for the more colourful- red velvet, sprinkles, M&M and many more.
The joint is small, so it's best to take the cup and amble on the pavement while taking small bites or visiting at an uncommon hour if you're interested to stay put and eat.
Coming to the big question - can this yogurt topple your other dessert options?
Well, on some days, definitely. On a normal day, you would be spending roughly 200 on the yogurt (I recommend taking at least a size up from the smallest with one or two toppings.) It can replace your midday meal with a hearty and cold delight.

If you’re in Mulund and want to enjoy a lively street-food experience with lots of options, this is the place to be.
